Rae (release-engineer): Release-train bulletin: starting 22:00 UTC today we're instituting a targeted freeze for billing-related routes until 10:00 UTC (+12h). Reason: downstream DB team has a schema migration that may change latency characteristics for billing queries. Please avoid merges that touch /v1/billing, /v1/usage, billing-worker, or any migration-related config.
Kim (prod-eng): Ack. Does this affect model rollouts / embeddings?
Rae (release-engineer): No impact to model runtime or general inference. This is limited to services that call billing databases. Non-billing services can continue normal cadence.
Devon: We've a partner launch scheduled that hits usage endpoints heavily. I will delay the deployment and ping partners.
Tessa (oncall): Escalation plan? If we see sustained p95 billing API > 1.5s for 3mins do we auto-rollback?
Rae (release-engineer): Yes. Escalation thresholds: p95 /v1/usage > 1.5s for 3m -> rollback deploys that touched billing; error rate > 1% for 5m -> page infra and DBA. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/billing-migration (internal).
Elena (pm): I'll post a short note to #customers-ops and #product explaining the limited freeze and why we delayed the partner launch.
Kim (prod-eng): Can we whitelist a single canary for telemetry testing? Need to validate latency post-migration.
Rae (release-engineer): Yes — we allow a single small-batch canary (10rps) if it uses the dedicated billing-canary tag. Coordinate with Tessa first.
DeployBot: Action: release-freeze applied to services [billing-worker, api-gateway:/v1/billing, api-gateway:/v1/usage] by Rae at 22:05 UTC. Webhooks to CI for those services suspended.
Tessa (oncall): I'll enable synthetic checks against the canary and monitor dashboards. Linking dash: https://dash.internal.redwood/boards/billing-latency
Devon: Pushed a rollback-safe flag to the partner branch and paused rollout. Notifying partner via email now.
Rae (release-engineer): Quick note on changelogs: any change touching billing must include a one-line risk note under the "Release Train" section and reference the migration ticket #DB-914.
Elena (pm): Will add the note to this week's changelog and flag customers with high usage.
DeployBot: Scheduled window for emergency hotfixes: 02:00-04:00 UTC (DBA on standby). To request emergency deploy, comment `@DeployBot emergency-deploy <service>` in this thread and include rollback plan.
Rae (release-engineer): Closing plan: freeze now -> monitor until migration completes -> 10:00 UTC verify metrics -> lift if stable. If any threshold hit, rollback and escalate. I will post an update at 02:30 UTC and final lift notice after verification. Thanks everyone. :pray:
